stage: Exploratory extension, frozen before extension fits; original six profiles preserved.

profiles.ddm_lognormal_questions: Use positive lognormal question drift multipliers with mean one and code-specific log SD moment-matched to the R1 Normal-effect mean/SD; same trial drift SD and contaminant. Tests the latent Normal assumption. Neither fitted candidate is exactly true.
profiles.ddm_low_variation: Set question drift SD=0.08, trial drift SD=0 and contamination=0; retain pilot population coefficients. A deliberately homogeneous, high-accuracy limit, not an estimate of the R1 population.

rationale: Calibrated generators test exact candidate families. Positive skew and a homogeneous limit test dependence on latent-effect assumptions and parameter regime, as required before a mechanism interpretation.
primary: Same composite screening, grouped folds and question-level SE; all inconclusive/failed outcomes retained.
